subtasks.title: Unit Testing: Component Tests
subtasks.description: Write and verify unit tests for all React components, ensuring correct rendering and props handling.

subtasks.title: Unit Testing: Service Tests
subtasks.description: Test all service modules (API, storage, utilities) for correct logic and error handling.

subtasks.title: Unit Testing: Utility Functions
subtasks.description: Write tests for all utility/helper functions, covering normal and edge cases.

subtasks.title: Unit Testing: Edge Cases
subtasks.description: Identify and test edge cases for all core logic and components.

subtasks.title: Integration Testing: Component Interactions
subtasks.description: Test how components interact with each other, including prop drilling and context usage.

subtasks.title: Integration Testing: API Integrations
subtasks.description: Verify that API calls are correctly integrated and handled in the UI.

subtasks.title: Integration Testing: Data Flow
subtasks.description: Test data flow between components, state management, and services.

subtasks.title: Integration Testing: State Management
subtasks.description: Check that state updates propagate correctly and consistently.

subtasks.title: E2E Testing: User Flow Tests
subtasks.description: Create end-to-end tests for critical user flows (e.g., logging a meal, viewing dashboard).

subtasks.title: E2E Testing: Critical Paths
subtasks.description: Test the most important user journeys for reliability and correctness.

subtasks.title: E2E Testing: Performance Tests
subtasks.description: Add E2E tests to measure and verify app performance under normal and heavy usage.

subtasks.title: E2E Testing: Error Scenarios
subtasks.description: Test how the app handles errors and edge cases in E2E flows.

subtasks.title: Security Testing: Audit
subtasks.description: Run a security audit on dependencies and codebase.

subtasks.title: Security Testing: Authentication
subtasks.description: Test authentication flows for vulnerabilities and correct behavior.

subtasks.title: Security Testing: Data Encryption
subtasks.description: Verify that sensitive data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

subtasks.title: Security Testing: API Security
subtasks.description: Check API endpoints for security best practices and vulnerabilities.

subtasks.title: Performance Testing: Load Tests
subtasks.description: Run load tests to measure app performance under stress.

subtasks.title: Performance Testing: Concurrent Users
subtasks.description: Test app behavior with multiple simultaneous users.

subtasks.title: Performance Testing: Memory Leaks
subtasks.description: Check for memory leaks in the app during prolonged use.

subtasks.title: Performance Testing: Response Times
subtasks.description: Measure and verify API and UI response times.

subtasks.title: Accessibility Testing: WCAG Compliance
subtasks.description: Run automated and manual tests for WCAG accessibility compliance.

subtasks.title: Accessibility Testing: Screen Readers
subtasks.description: Test the app with screen readers for usability.

subtasks.title: Accessibility Testing: Keyboard Navigation
subtasks.description: Verify that all interactive elements are accessible via keyboard.

subtasks.title: Accessibility Testing: Color Contrast
subtasks.description: Check color contrast ratios for all UI elements.

subtasks.title: Code Quality: Linter Checks
subtasks.description: Run linter and fix all code style issues.

subtasks.title: Code Quality: TypeScript Errors
subtasks.description: Fix all TypeScript errors and warnings.

subtasks.title: Code Quality: Code Coverage
subtasks.description: Check and improve test coverage for all modules.

subtasks.title: Code Quality: Documentation Review
subtasks.description: Review and update code documentation.

subtasks.title: User Experience: Responsive Design
subtasks.description: Test and verify responsive layouts on all devices.

subtasks.title: User Experience: Animations
subtasks.description: Check that all animations are smooth and accessible.

subtasks.title: User Experience: Loading States
subtasks.description: Verify that loading states are handled gracefully.

subtasks.title: User Experience: Offline Mode
subtasks.description: Test app functionality in offline mode.

subtasks.title: Documentation: API Docs
subtasks.description: Update and verify API documentation.

subtasks.title: Documentation: Testing Guide
subtasks.description: Add or update a guide for running and writing tests.

subtasks.title: Documentation: Known Issues
subtasks.description: Document any known issues or limitations.

subtasks.title: Documentation: Release Notes
subtasks.description: Create release notes summarizing changes and improvements.
